metadata.track_name: Add XNL formatter and unified XNL API
metadata.goal: Convert archived OpenSpec change add-xnl-formatter into Codument archive format.

phase.name: Implementation
phase.goal: Implementation tasks converted from OpenSpec checklist.

task.name: Design formatting rules (indentation, spacing, attribute ordering, raw/text preservation) aligned with XNL grammar.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Design formatting rules (indentation, spacing, attribute ordering, raw/text preservation) aligned with XNL grammar.

task.name: Implement `XNL.stringify` supporting default single-line and configurable pretty output (indent/spacing options).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Implement `XNL.stringify` supporting default single-line and configurable pretty output (indent/spacing options).

task.name: Add `XNL.parseMulti`, `XNL.parseSingle`, and `XNL.parseUnique` wrappers that delegate to existing parse helpers and return warnings.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add `XNL.parseMulti`, `XNL.parseSingle`, and `XNL.parseUnique` wrappers that delegate to existing parse helpers and return warnings.

task.name: Export new APIs from package entry points and update README/examples.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Export new APIs from package entry points and update README/examples.

task.name: Add tests for stringify (compact and pretty) and XNL.* parse wrappers.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add tests for stringify (compact and pretty) and XNL.* parse wrappers.

task.name: Ensure `npm run build` and `npm run test` pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Ensure `npm run build` and `npm run test` pass.
